text:
tara: Postmortem follow-up — we mapped the failure chain to auth throttles -> registry timeouts -> storage retry storms. Need owners, short timelines, and a recurrence detection plan. Who volunteers?

ben: I can handle vendor liaison + SLA extract (INF-4801). Will ask for a remediation timeline and escalation contacts. ETA 48h. :calendar:

yuki: I'll own registry fallback (INF-4802) — implement read-only degraded mode, warm local cache for hot models, and a rollback script. Draft runbook + staging sim by next Tue.

omar: I'll take auth hardening (INF-4803): client-side token caching with safe TTLs, short-lived tokens, refresh jitter, and a circuit-breaker. Need Security sign-off. 10d.

incident-bot: Epic created: https://tracker/INF-4800 "Dependency resilience: auth+registry". Tasks INF-4801..INF-4806.

tara: Ops asks: (1) composite alert correlating auth_p95 with registry error rate, (2) monthly recurrence digest and 90-day dashboard.

ben: Looping Legal once vendor provides remediation plan. Recommend asking vendor for RTO/RPO for token endpoints and a snippet of their mitigation runbook.

yuki: Note on TTLs — aggressive TTLs risk stale model outputs. I'll run a staging replay harness that measures quality drift vs TTL and include config knobs.

omar: I'll coordinate with Product on acceptable staleness and with Security for rotation cadence.

legal: On standby. Please include vendor milestones and verification steps in their remediation plan so we can evaluate contractual next steps.

tara: Action summary to add to INF-4800 epic:
- ben: vendor SLA & remediation ask (INF-4801) — 48h
- yuki: registry fallback + TTL sim + rollback (INF-4802) — next Tue
- omar: auth hardening + token-caching + security sign-off (INF-4803) — 10d
- ops: alert + digest (INF-4804) — 3d

Please attach blockers to the epic. We'll review in the ops sync Friday. If vendor timeline is weak, escalate to account execs and loop Legal. Closing this thread and moving tracking to INF-4800. :white_check_mark:
